fields.name: apiBaseUrl
fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Backend API origin. Filled automatically when the page is generated from a resource.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Primary Resource Slug
fields.description: Slug of the resource this landing page belongs to. Filled automatically.

fields.name: gated
fields.label: Gating for this resource (read-only)
fields.description: Shows what the backend recorded for this resource, so you can see it without leaving the editor. Gating follows where a file is stored — private S3 bucket means registration is required, AEM DAM means public — so changing this does nothing: the block asks the API per file when the page renders, and the backend rewrites this field on its next sync. To actually change it, move the file's storage in the backend admin.

options.name: Gated — private S3 bucket, registration required

fields.name: itemTitle
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Display title for this download. Falls back to the resource title or file name.

fields.name: itemDescription
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Supporting copy. On Feature cards this doubles as the 'what's inside' line.

fields.name: buttonLabel
fields.label: Button Label
fields.description: Defaults by file type (Download PDF, Download PowerPoint, Watch Video...).

fields.name: file
fields.label: File
fields.description: Pick or upload a DAM file (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, ZIP, MP4). On the next resource sync, this becomes a tracked file on the current resource page - no slug needed.

fields.name: filePath
fields.label: File Path (Manual)
fields.description: Paste the DAM path here if the picker does not open the expected folder or the file still needs to be uploaded first. Example: /content/dam/edge/misc/PDFs/example.pdf. Overrides the picker value.

fields.name: resourceSlug
fields.label: Resource Slug (existing resource)
fields.description: Only for linking an EXISTING backend resource by slug — pulls its title, file, thumbnail, and gating. Filled automatically for file items once they sync.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image / Poster
fields.description: Thumbnail for Document cards or poster for Video items. Slug-backed items fall back to the resource thumbnail.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: Video URL
fields.description: YouTube, Vimeo, or MP4 URL for Video items. Slug-backed items fall back to the resource's video.

fields.name: displayStyle
fields.label: Display Style
fields.description: Auto renders the dedicated, color-coded card for the file type. Pick a specific type card to force it, or use Informative / Compact row / Grouped.

fields.name: gated
fields.label: Gating for this file (read-only)
fields.description: Shows where this file is stored, which is what decides gating. A file in the private S3 bucket requires registration; a file in the AEM DAM is public and cannot be gated, because AEM publishes it to the public tier as soon as a page referencing it is published. Uploaded files are stamped here automatically; a DAM file you picked yourself stays blank. Changing it does nothing — the block asks the API per file when the page renders. To gate a file that is already open, migrate it in the backend admin — no re-upload needed.

options.name: Not stamped — picked from the DAM, so public
Gated — private S3 bucket, registration required

fields.name: informativeAudienceLabel
fields.label: Informative Audience Label Override
fields.description: Optional label for the audience metadata row. Defaults to Primary Audience.

fields.name: informativeAudienceText
fields.label: Informative Audience Text Override
fields.description: Optional audience text. Falls back to the resource audience tags. Leave blank to hide when no tags exist.

fields.name: informativeTimeLabel
fields.label: Informative Time Label Override
fields.description: Optional label for the time metadata row. Defaults to Time.

fields.name: informativeTimeText
fields.label: Informative Time Text Override
fields.description: Optional time text. Falls back to the resource length tag. Leave blank to hide when no tag exists.

fields.name: informativeFormatLabel
fields.label: Informative Format Label Override
fields.description: Optional label for the format metadata row. Defaults to Format.

fields.name: informativeFormatText
fields.label: Informative Format Text Override
fields.description: Optional format text. Falls back to PDF, Video, PowerPoint, bundle, or the resource type.

fields.name: s3File
fields.label: S3 File (gated)
fields.description: Pick a gated file from the private S3 bucket instead of pasting its slug. The file stays private — its link is minted only after the visitor completes the registration form. Options are grouped by the bucket folder and regenerated by `npm run build:s3-options`; entries marked 'not published yet' will not resolve on the live site until you publish them in Filament.
